**Relationship signals:**
- A Conversation belongs to zero or one Person (when person_id is null, it lands in "Company" inbox)
- A Conversation has many CallEvents / TimelineEntries
- A Person has many Conversations
- A Person has many Tags
- An Agent/User can be assigned to many Conversations
- Voicemail is a subtype of CallEvent with an audio_url and optional transcript

### Non-obvious logic

1. **Company Inbox routing rule:** FUB automatically places inbound calls/voicemails from unrecognized numbers into the "Company" inbox bucket. A number is "unrecognized" when it doesn't match any existing Person record's phone field. Once the user clicks "Add person" or links to an existing person, the conversation migrates out of Company inbox to that person's record.

2. **Count semantics:** The left-rail badge "Company (54)" is total unmatched conversation threads, not individual messages. The list header "43 Unread Messages" is the subset currently unread. Individual rows show per-thread message counts (e.g., "(541) 207-9190 `3`" = 3 events in that thread).

3. **Voicemail transcript preview:** The third line of each row shows a truncated voicemail-to-text transcript, not typed notes. The "or call 877-556-9255. Thank you." and "Press 0 to speak to an agent. Press 9 to opt out or call 877-…" transcripts reveal these are all robocall/TCPA inbound spam voicemails — the Company inbox commonly accumulates spam calls since there's no person to filter against.

4. **"Unknown → Matt Ryan" call entry:** The label pattern "[caller] → [agent]" means an inbound call was connected through the FUB/Twilio phone system and routed to agent Matt Ryan. The caller shows as "Unknown" because no person record exists. This is an answered call (duration 00:28), unlike the voicemails which were unanswered.

5. **Add person panel trigger:** This right panel appears specifically when the selected conversation has no linked Person. If a person IS linked, this panel would instead show that person's contact record/summary [INFERRED].

6. **Search Google link:** Provides an external reverse-phone-lookup shortcut to help the agent identify the unknown caller before deciding to add them as a contact or ignore.

7. **"Close" button semantics:** Closes (archives) the conversation thread in the inbox, not the panel. The conversation moves to the "Closed" sub-folder and the next conversation would auto-load [INFERRED from FUB conventions].

8. **Message count badge on rows:** Teal circle with white count number. Positioned immediately after the phone number, before the date. Represents total events (not just unread) in the thread.

9. **Tab row "Unread" vs "All":** Switching to "Unread" would filter from 54 total to 43 shown. The "All" tab shows all 54 threads regardless of read status.

10. **Bottom compose bar:** Spans the full width of the detail panel. The "Write a note or @mention someone" pattern is consistent with FUB's internal notes system (not visible to the lead). "@" triggers a team-member mention autocomplete. The "Create Note" button is amber/orange (active color) suggesting it submits any text in the field — it is always visible even on empty input.

11. **Far-right sliver field list:** This is almost certainly a second panel/drawer showing an existing contact's details that is slightly peeking in from the right edge, or the contact detail pane for a previously selected person. The field list (Stage, Source, Price, Timeframe, Tags, Lender, enrichment fields) matches FUB's standard Person record sidebar exactly. It is NOT part of the Add Person panel.
